p.d: Desired Orientation. Grizzy finds a compass that indicates the direction of one's own desires.
Chews Wisely. What will Sugar do when the floor ends up covered in gum?

Very Important Pup. A Very Important Pup visits Pup School for the opening of the brand new bug hotel.
Pippa's Zimbabwean Nyama. Pippa is making nyama, a chicken stew that uses tasty spring greens.
Climbing Plants. Aaron and the Buds learn how climbing plants grow tall and reach for the sun!
Too Hot! A paper plate crab is the first make of the day, and an old wooden spoon becomes a spoon monster. The Recycling Express provides yogurt pots to make a palm tree.
The Balamory Games. With the games in peril, Ava seeks a new chieftain - unaware she is perfect for the role!
The Playing Badge. Animated preschool series. Naughty Monkey is visited by his cousins, and it turns out they are even naughtier than Naughty Monkey!
Octonauts and the Flamingos. Preschool animation. The Octonauts wade through a swamp to find a lost flamingo chick before hungry predators do.
The Vida the Vet Book. Sunny tags along on house calls to interview Vida for his book... about her. It's a musical!
Tomatina Festival, Bunol, Spain. Can the Go Jetters fix their own 'glitch' at the biggest food fight in the world?
Personal Space. When Cosima finally finds a quiet place to read her book, she realises peace and quiet aren't all they're made out to be. Where's Big Lizard when she needs him?

The Race. After a garden barbecue, Ziff, Pipp and Button turn straws and snacks into agility games.
Summer. Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble holds a swimming gala, while Justin and his friends enjoy summer at the seaside.
Wollemi Pine. Matilda and the Fact Pack explore the Wollemi pine, a plant from dinosaur times.
You Laugh You Lose. Penny coaches PC Plum for the You Laugh You Lose contest, but it's trickier than expected.
Second Opinion. Pearl and Gadabout don't see eye to eye when treating Mara's curly fin.
Typewriter. Bluey, Snickers and Winton are ambushed by the Terriers on the way to see Calypso.
Mae, Bee and the Acorn Exchange. It's Mae and Bee's first Acorn Exchange Day, but Mae's attempts to teach Little Acorn the gnomish way tests Mae's mighty patience to the limit!
Quiet Moments. Tralala finds the house too noisy until she joins the dust bunnies' rock band.
The Stuck Together Wish. Rafi makes a wish to be stuck together with Ruby, making playtime special.
Is It Healthy or Not? It's curry night, and Nick writes a song to help him remember to buy lots of healthy ingredients, but will he remember to buy Norman's dog treats?
Make Something Epic Day. Love Monster wants to make an epic fort for his friends to play inside but isn't quite sure how. He learns that he needs to make a plan and take it step by step.
Double Playdate. Live-action children's show. When Topsy and Tim's friends Tony Welch and Vinda come to play, things don't quite go to plan at first.
Sculptor. Dylan the sculptor wants to sell his statues, but his statues have minds of their own!
Keen Keith. Keith is happy to help the Piggies, but their work is sabotaged!
Like Clockwork. When Yukee's precious clockwork music box breaks, her garden friends cheer her up with a life-size clockwork performance of their own.
The Spider and the Fly. Children's sign language poetry series. Aimee and Ashley discover The Spider and the Fly by Mary Botham Howitt.
Trapped! An impatient Great Gnanna gets accidentally trapped with Gadabout in the dispensary. It's a tense time for both of them, while Zog and Pearl race to set them free.
Typewriter. Bluey, Snickers and Winton are ambushed by the Terriers on the way to see Calypso.

p.t: Andy and the Band: Rock Star School
p.d: Rock Star Club. The school is turned into a rock star club - but will it fool a famous rock duo?
It's Time to Look for Frogs. At the wetland centre, JoJo and her friends Alfie, Raya, Jaxon and Isaiah find frog spawn.
A Feather Bed. Oona and Baba search for soft bedding for their burrow.
I Love Going to Granny and Grandpa's It's Just That ... Animation about a brother and sister. Charlie and Lola are going to see their grandparents, but Lola is worried.
Colly Wobble's Flippers. After Colly Wobble loses her shoes, Moon Baby shows her a magical shoe tree in Storyland.
A Gift from the Heart. MeMo and BaBa try to create a surprise gift for Gramma Leeba, but something always goes wrong. Gramma Leeba reassures them that the best gift is made with love.
Upsy Daisy's Special Stone. In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Upsy Daisy gives her special stone to Igglepiggle to look after.
Perrie Edwards - The Shape of My Heart. Join Perrie for a soothing story about the shapes that make up the world we love.
This Is CBeebies. Programmes start at 6.00am.
Baby Jake Loves Jumping. The adventures of magical Baby Jake and friends. Baby Jake and the Hamsternauts go on a space adventure and enjoy jumping.
Storytime. Animation. Bing wants Flop to read him his favourite book as he has his bath, but Bing joins in with the story too enthusiastically.
Happity Birthday. Tralala and Batty use clever mathematics to get enough cake for the guests at their party.   Followed by Small Potatoes.
Flying Cherry. Cherry dreams of soaring through the sky. The Piggies build a plane, but her first flight is a disaster. Cherry begins to doubt herself, but the Piggies won't give up!
Coconut. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Coconut getting his moment in the limelight.
Leaning Tower of Pisa. Searching for a G.O Star at the Leaning Tower of Pisa, Kym and Lars must stop Glitch from damaging the famous landmark and use the G.O Fix to save the day.
The Chickening. Carrying a giant chicken to the country fair proves trickier than Mojo and Bo expected!
Piper's City Safari. When Safari Park is closed for the day, Koko, Wilson and Brewster give Piper a surprise tour and discover all the exotic wildlife right in their own backyard.
Knack. Sula, Pando, Flop and Padget all have a knack, a special thing that only they can do. Bing is frustrated when all his own knacks are easy for everyone else to do, too.
Vaccination. Bing is brave for his vaccination as he is looking forward to the Hoppity Voosh sticker Dr Molly will give him afterwards. But then he finds out that there are none left!
The Dressing Up Badge. Animated preschool series. It's Enid's birthday. She doesn't like surprises or cakes, so the Squirrels will throw her a dressing up party. But how?
The Getting On Badge. Animated preschool series. Fox, Badger, Mole, Vole and Worm are not getting on. Can Duggee and the Squirrels suggest ways that they can all live peacefully?
Animals. Mum is playing the animal game on Bingo's back.
Easter Island, Chile. Animated adventure comedy series. When the Grimbots build their own Easter Island statue, it collapses and threatens the ancient Moai statues.
The Tale of the Sleepy Hedgehog. Animated series. When Peter takes Mrs Tiggy-Winkle home in time for winter hibernation, he doesn't realise how much trouble she might be!
Urchin Invasion. Animated deep sea adventures. The Octonauts head to the kelp forest to visit Shellington's sister Pearl and her newborn son Periwinkle.
Vida's Wandering Wonders. When Vida's vet bag goes missing, she and her Sweetwoodian friends need to track it down.
Nine-Legged Bill. Cap'n Gail's tall tale of a nine-legged octopus in Lake Swoppiton has everyone panicking. But Mojo and Bo wonder: is the story real, or is Cap'n Gail up to something?
Treetops. Oi, oi, shout it from the treetops! It's my Treetops Challenge - from climbers to squats, and then star jumps. Climbing all the way up to the Activate!
Boating Fun. Justin and his friend head to a marina for lots of boating fun. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble has ordered a new inflatable boat to take fishing. What could possibly go wrong?
Asparagus. Dad tells Bluey to mind her manners at the table - they're not animals. But when Bluey gets her hands on a stick of magic asparagus, she shows them everyone's got a wild side.
Unicorse. Bluey's bedtime story is disturbed by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world.
The Making Music Badge. Animated preschool series. When the Squirrels find Duggee playing the saxophone, they want to have a go, too.
The Whistling Badge. Animated preschool series. When Egg goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. The Squirrels want to learn how to whistle too.
Wide Awake Boom. Boom hasn't been sleeping and is so tired he crashes into a tree. Zog and the doctors try everything to get him back to sleep.
My Fair Pancake. When the Emperor Penguin visits the berg, he discovers Pancake is a long-lost prince. Pancake learns how to act royal, but all the attention goes to his head.
The Shadow Wish. At a sleepover with Ruby, Rafi wishes their shadows could dance on their own. When they cause mischief, she realises sleepovers are exciting, but you still need to sleep.
Mission Bat. The ducklings try to get rid of a bat that has interrupted their game. But Weasy thinks it's supercool and ditches the ducklings to become a comic book hero with a bat sidekick.
Iron Zola/Aunt May's Birthday Blowout. Zola is heroic. Aunt May's birthday balloon gets lost.
Snag Hotel. The Octonauts find a threatened tree that must be moved - the creatures inside disagree!
Mission: Puzzle Room. When Pranksy locks the puzzle room door, the spies must solve every riddle to escape.
Coconut Roll. Ginger must navigate chaos amid rolling Coconutdons and tail-swatting Pineapplesauruses.
Winter Wonderland. Evil Pea chases the Veggies with a giant snowball after covering the supermarket in ice.
Episode 15. Comedy sketch show for younger viewers. Antiques expert Ann Teak gets more than she bargained for when she examines a Georgian dress.
Class Photo Day. It's class photo day, but Biscuit arrives with a box on her head. When the pups realise she is embarrassed about her 'fur' style, they work together to make her feel better.
Tilly's Swiss Brunsli Biscuits. Tilly is making spiced chocolate biscuits shaped like beautiful snowflakes.
Slugs and Snails. Aaron, Nelly and Abbie follow Chatterpot's slimy trail to discover how slugs and snails love to munch around in the garden and help keep the garden tidy and magical.
Dusty, Old Box. A dusty, old box makes Rebecca sneeze! Murphi dreams up some make ideas to help reveal what's inside, including a tissue box monster and a flamingo sock puppet.
Deep Sea Adventure. After diving in Balamory Bay, PC Plum dreams of taking the nursery children underwater.
The Party Badge. Animated preschool series. There's a parcel for Duggee, and it's wrapped up like a present. Maybe it's Duggee's birthday! The Squirrels decide to throw a party.
Octonauts and the Tiger Shark. Preschool animation. Tweak must help her friend Sandy the sea turtle escape a hungry tiger shark.
Popcorn's Spooky Surprise. Popcorn is afraid of a spooky corn maze. Vida helps him conquer his fear of the unknown.
Holi Festival of Colour, India. Glitch takes all of the colourful powder from the Festival of Colour in Dwarka, India.
A Place to Sleep. A playful Big Lizard accidentally breaks his own bath bed. Where will he sleep now?
Hoops Van Badger. Stripes worries that the stage isn't loud enough when his hero comes to play a gig.
Theatre. On a rainy day, the Froglets create a shadow show for Bertie and their puppet friends.
Hobbies. Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble looks for a hobby, while Justin meets a friend who plays powerchair football as his hobby.
Bamboo. Chef Ching introduces the Fact Pack to bamboo. They have fun discovering how bamboo is prepared for cooking, and how it can be used in so many other ways.
Dance Away. It's the nursery dance, but Ava feels she can't dance like everyone else.
Gadabout Blabbermouth. Winton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles, but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.
Baby Race. Mum remembers when Bluey and Judo were babies and their race to see who would walk first!
Mae, Bee and the Giant Strawberry. Mae and Bee find a giant strawberry, but they may have bitten off more than they can chew!
Coaty Coat. Sid wants Tralala to wear her coat outside, but won't the coat get cold too?
The Do It All Wish. Rafi's wish to be in two places at once leads to mix-ups. She realises it's better to focus on one thing at a time.
Family of Cats. With help from some kittens, Nick and the Popcasters put on a big concert at the old town hall for two very special mums.
Do Something New Day. Love Monster want to show Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny's cousin Eager Beaver something new when she visits Fluffytown.
New Clothes. Live-action children's show. Topsy and Tim are growing out of their old, matching twin clothes, so Mummy buys them new jeans.
School Crossing Patroller. Dylan wants to help kids get to school safely using his stop sign.
Captain Keith. Keith dreams of a pirate adventure. The Piggies build a wheeled ship and sail across Fine Forest for treasure, but Wilf plans to steal it!
The Piano. Yukee struggles to come up with a tune for a new song. Can Sonny and Paulie help?
Daffodils. Children's sign language poetry series. Donna and Ashley discover Daffodils by William Wordsworth, and A Musical Instrument by Elizabeth Barrett Browning.
Speedy Dragon. When an outbreak of lupine lurgy causes the doctors' patients to howl like wolves, Zog races to treat as many creatures as he can, with chaotic results.
Baby Race. Mum remembers when Bluey and Judo were babies and their race to see who would walk first!

p.t: Don't Tell the Bride: Let It Snow
p.d: Steve from Rotherham plans a wedding with an icy twist for his bride Emma, who wants an impressive, upmarket affair. But will his big ideas leave him snowed under?
The One with the Wannabe DJ Groom: Bride Ellis has dreamed her whole life of a quiet church wedding. Luke decides to plan a rave-inspired do...
Xavier Mufraggi, the CEO of Club Med North America, goes undercover, disguised as a laid-back surfer, in his own resorts, to see the impact that his growth plans are having.

p.t: Tad the Lost Explorer and the...
p.d: ...Curse of the Mummy: (2022) Animated family adventure. After Tad accidentally unleashes a curse - doh! - he and his friends must find the Emerald Tablet to save the world.
(2020) Madcap adventure-comedy video game adaptation with Jim Carrey and Ben Schwartz. Can nippy ring-chasing hedgehog Sonic escape the clutches of an evil moustachioed scientist?
(2001) Raucous comedy. A Las Vegas casino-owner sets up a unique game for six punters: a race across America, hunting for $2m. Starring John Cleese, Rowan Atkinson and Whoopi Goldberg.
(2019) Animated spy comedy caper with the voice of Will Smith. The 'world's most awesome spy' gets framed and has to go undercover as a pigeon to prove his innocence.
(2022) Going-for-gold action. Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg compare abs as they scour the globe for an olde explorer's lost gold. The heat is on. The time is right. Only the best survive.
(2011) Thriller with Jason Statham and Donald Sutherland. A hitman is ordered to kill his mentor, but then takes on the dead man's son as an apprentice. Could get complicated... and deadly.
(2024) Mia Goth stars in the conclusion to Ti West's X horror trilogy. Can Maxine Minx make the leap from porn star to bona fide actor in neon-drenched, Night Stalker-terrorised 1980s LA?
(1982) Sidney J Furie's seminal horror stars Barbara Hershey as a divorced mother of three who becomes the victim of a poltergeist that submits her to multiple violent and sexual assaults.

p.d: Sneeze: Nina answers questions about science from children around the country.
Na Liosmoir Agus An Tsiog: Twins Lenny and Larry, who have been born with unfortunate clouds over their heads, meet a rapping fairy who can remove them.
Zoom learns all about keeping warm, how insulation works and goes to see a house made of straw and mud! (SL)
Joe leaves the depot with a sore tooth but luckily his deliveries today are at the dentist. (SL)
Cormac discovers what gives popcorn its pop sound and Auntie B makes some other mystery sounds! (SL)
Gold orders a chocolate statue of herself to impress Silver at her party, but Oxygen finds it difficult transporting it in the random Atom Town weather.
Dee encourages a friend to say 'toothbrush', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see a blue toothbrush, a stripy toothbrush, a night-time toothbrush and a giant toothbrush.
It's a lovely snowy day at the zoo, and the Peeks are feeding the penguins before going ice-skating.
It's bedtime and as The Wee Littles head upstairs for bed, they discover Jeremy bouncing on a pogo-stick but he is asleep.
Beaky thinks she can sing beautifully but what comes out is a siren-like squawk.
The whole family are on the roof star gazing. They build a telescope to take a look at all the wonders of space and the moon.
Henry meets a friendly Digger. There is a house that needs to be built but with the builder off work with a tummy ache it's up to Henry to save the day.
Henry meets a friendly Daffodil. He is getting ready to welcome some new plants to the garden when they arrive a day early. Henry becomes a Gardener for the day.
Hotel: Dad gets embroiled in a game of Hotel, where Bluey and Bingo run a crazy hotel and Dad is the beleaguered guest.
Rug Island: Bluey and Bingo pretend that they are living on a desert island in the back garden. Dad needs to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make Rug Island his home too.
Whale Watching: Bluey promises her customer Bingo 'the best tour ever' in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in and they are too tired to play after a late night.
Na Margaí: Tá cúig dollar faighte ag Bluey ó shióg na bhfiacla agus níl deireadh ar bith leis na rudaí a bheidh sí in ann a cheannach ag an margadh.
Daniel can't wait to race the crafty car he made at school with Prince Wednesday! But Prince Wednesday is busy playing with Jodi now. Is Prince Wednesday still Daniel's friend?
Daniel and Miss Elaina are playing together at the park. When their new friend Jodi shows up to play, Daniel worries that Miss Elaina likes Jodi more than him.
Hedge Flies High: Eager to experience the thrill of flying, Hedge tests Toad's newly acquired power kite. Unfortunately, this helps the Weasels come up with an idea to enter Toad Hall.
Regatta: Everyone is determined to win the annual regatta race, especially the previous winner, Ratty. But even he has to learn that winning isn't the only goal.
Mossy dochreidte: Téann Oona i bhfostú i sreangán iascaireachta cóngarach d'Aill na bhFaoileán!
Sliogán speisialta: Tá Baba tinn agus caithfidh sé fanacht sa pholl.
Tacsaí turtair: Tagann Bernadette, cara le Bernie, ar cuairt chuige ach éiríonn sí i dtrioblóid nuair a scuabann an taoide léi í.
Bláithín's favourite crayon is missing on World Fairy Friendship Day! The fairies retrace Cuán's steps to find it - and uncover a lovely surprise along the way.
There's a big storm on the way and Whizz is afraid of thunder and lightning! But with some musical creativity from Bellie and the Forest Kids, she soon gets over her fears. (SL)
Who could resist eating a delicious Berry Bun? Bellie feels very guilty when he realises he gobbled up Whizz's berry bun. Happily the Forest Kids help him make her a new one. (SL)
Kyan wants to climb Mount Everest, but his daring plan is interrupted by Grandmaster Glitch, who's careering down the mountain in a giant snowball!
The Go Jetters head to Scotland in search of the Loch Ness Monster, but Grandmaster Glitch plans to catch Nessie first. If only his Grimbler was up to the job.
The Frozen Planet: The Game Catchers land on the Frozen Planet but have to travel through large tunnels of ice before they can meet the local alien kids.
All It Takes Is a Pinch of Courage: The Game Catchers land on the Planet of Constructions, where they learn the game 'Steal the Monster's Treasure'.
When Pablo gets Chicken Pops, so do all the Book Animals. Soon everyone is itching and they don't know how to make it stop. Luckily in the Real World Mum has the answer.
Pablo wants to play with his shiny things, but his cardigan is in the way making a scary shape. Nobody knows how to get past it until Llama bravely leads the way.
Shop: Stanley is looking after the shop while Jose makes a delivery.
Farm: Stanley helps Amare with some planting and harvesting, but of course Stanley has some ideas to make it faster and more fun.
Perfect Moments: The final continues. Beacon's tactical change has brought Ballybraddan back in the game. Will it be enough to defeat the Total Hurling of Woodborough?
Detective Doodle is on the case! Someone has been making everyone's snacks disappear, and it's up to our Doodly hero, and her partner Pencil to track down the culprit! (SL)
When Doodle Girl gets lost in Busybody City, she must outsmart the crossword-obsessed Crossword Master and his puzzling maze in order to make it out in time for lunch. (SL)
Ella, Blaze and Lucy want to know more about the fabled court of Camelot.

The Date Night Variable. Howard discovers that he can't escape his mother - even in space! Back on earth, meanwhile, Raj turns his existence as a third wheel into an art form. S6, Ep1
The Decoupling Fluctuation. After learning Penny is thinking about breaking up with Leonard, Sheldon tries to intervene. Howard is being picked on in space by the astronauts. S6, Ep2
The Higgs Boson Observation. While the pressure of being in space starts to take its toll on Howard, Amy feels threatened when Sheldon hires a young female assistant, Alex. S6, Ep3
The Re-Entry Minimization. When Howard returns from space, he doesn't get the hero's welcome he expected. Meanwhile, Game Night turns into a battle of the sexes. S6, Ep4
The Holographic Excitation. The gang celebrates Halloween at Stuart's comic book store. Leonard and Penny discover a new spark in their relationship with a scientific seduction. S6, Ep5
The Extract Obliteration. Sheldon's friendship with renowned scientist Stephen Hawking is threatened by a game of 'Words with Friends.' S6, Ep6
The Habitation Configuration. Bernadette pressures Howard to move out of his mother's house. Sheldon finds himself caught in the middle of a fight between Amy and Wil Wheaton. S6, Ep7
The 43 Peculiarity. Howard and Raj try to understand why Sheldon disappears every afternoon at 2:45. Leonard and Penny wrestle with jealousy in their relationship. S6, Ep8
The Parking Spot Escalation. When the University reassigns Sheldon's unused parking spot to Howard, the ensuing turf battle affects the whole gang. S6, Ep9
The Fish Guts Displacement. Sheldon plays nursemaid to a sick Amy, while Howard attempts to bond with his father-in-law on an upcoming fishing trip. S6, Ep10
The Santa Simulation. Sheldon unwillingly revisits some Christmas memories during a lively game of Dungeons and Dragons, while Raj joins the girls for ladies' night out. S6, Ep11
The Egg Salad Equivalency. Sheldon is accused of sexual harassment at the University and winds up dragging Leonard, Raj and Howard into the fray. S6, Ep12
The Bakersfield Expedition. Leonard's car is stolen when the guys take a road trip to a comic book convention in Bakersfield, dressed as Star Trek characters. S6, Ep13
The Cooper/Kripke Inversion. Outraged that he's being forced to work with his university nemesis, Barry Kripke, Sheldon faces a crisis of conscience. S6, Ep14
The Spoiler Alert Segmentation. When Sheldon and Leonard fight, it affects Penny and Amy's living arrangements. Meanwhile, Raj takes care of Mrs. Wolowitz while Howard is away. S6, Ep15
The Tangible Affection Proof. While the guys try to give their significant others the perfect Valentine's Day, Raj and Stuart throw a lonely people party at the comic book store. S6, Ep16
The Monster Isolation. After a terrible date, Raj vows to never leave his apartment again. Meanwhile, Penny actually impresses Sheldon with her acting skills. S6, Ep17
Contractual Obligation Implementation. Leonard, Sheldon and Howard try to advance the cause of women in science by speaking with junior high girls about their future careers. S6, Ep18
The Closet Reconfiguration. When Howard finds a letter from his father, he's forced to confront his past. And Leonard and Penny throw a grown-up cocktail party at the apartment. S6, Ep19
Scared Cyst-less. Dr. Sandra Lee treats Taylore, a young woman with unsightly elf-like bumps on her ears. Jose never goes out because of the baseball-sized lump on his head. S2, Ep1
A Lipoma Is Born. Barbara's back lump became more noticeable after she lost 131 pounds. Hilda's depression is a result of the multitude of bumps on her eyelids. S2, Ep3
Romancing The Lump. Dr. Sandra Lee treats Heather, who has a huge growth on her leg and fears removing it could leave a keloid scar. And, Paul has a giant hump on his back. S2, Ep5
The Lipoma Psychic. Roger returns and hope Dr. Lee can help with his gigantic nose growths. Christine has lost her essence due to a large growth on her shoulder. S3, Ep21
Lookin' For Love In Lumpy Places. Gabriel has a huge growth on his clavicle but is terrified of surgery. Karen has dealt with painful, scaly feet for 22 years with no diagnosis. S4, Ep1
The Emma H Episode. Bride Zoe hands all dress-choosing-responsibility over to Jo and Al. Plus, Bride Emma is determined to have her dream dress for when she renews her vows. S2, Ep30
Octavia's Story. Octavia has been bedbound for nearly a year. But, with her best friend as her worst enabler, can she choose between old habits and a new life? S7, Ep2
Not Afraid To Try New Things. A team of specialists guide brides through the process of selecting, fitting, altering and delivering each flawless dress in time for the perfect day. S14, Ep15
Randy, I Think I Got This. While new consultant Shay is excited to help with a surprise marriage proposal, former Miss USA Nia Sanchez has just one day to find her gown. S14, Ep17
There's A New Guy In Town. Kleinfeld hired its first male consultant! Bride Tolu contends with her opinionated sister, and Amanda needs a modest dress for her orthodox wedding. S14, Ep19

Mitch's Son. When the IRS accuses Sheldon of making a mistake, he stops at nothing to prove them wrong. Meanwhile, Dale is forced to get a colonoscopy. S4, Ep14

A Black Hole. The Coopers discuss the possibilities of black holes and alternate universes when Dr. Sturgis comes over for dinner. S4, Ep17
The Wild And Woolly World. Missy's first heartbreak triggers a series of events that lead the Cooper family to the brink. S4, Ep18
One Bad Night. Sheldon and Missy both run away from home, while Mary gets some upsetting news about her husband, George. S5, Ep1
A New Beau. Georgie and Mandy take matters into their own hands when Mary starts warming up to Fagenbacher. Also, Audrey struggles to cope with Connor's absence. S2, Ep22

Highland Fling. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Alexander Gauge & Hugh McDermott. King Richard sends Robin Hood and Friar Tuck on a mission to Scotland to collect a debt in the form of gold.

1977. Comedy. Directed by Norman Cohen. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Bill Maynard. Holiday camp employees enjoy their summer celebrations until a new manager arrives to spoil the fun.
1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. We meet a Spanish siren with castanets, meet Finland's biggest slappers, Lolo dives deep down with her snorkel and one man goes down in medical history.
2000. Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society.

1979. Sci-Fi. Director: John Cardos. Stars Jim Davis, Christopher Mitchum & Dorothy Malone. Aliens visit the house of a family. The house is sucked into a time warp that sends it back in time.
Who Are You? 1960. Stars Philip Bourneuf & Anna Lee. After a young girl recovers from scarlet fever, she rejects her parents and insists she is the recently deceased daughter of another family.
1952. Comedy directed by Maclean Rogers and starring Michael Bentine, Harry Secombe, Spike Milligan and Peter Sellers. Prof. Pureheart loses a secret formula in the grocery shop.
1959. The Unseeing Eye. Directed by Geoffrey Muller. Starring Russell Napier, John Stone and Denny Dayviss. A night worker returning home sees smoke and flames coming from a building. (S1, E30)
The Case of the Split Ticket. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. When O'Casey wins the lottery, they must find Albert before the ticket runs out.
1952. Drama. Directed by Philip Leacock. Starring John Gregson, Meg Buchanan & John Rae. Based on a true story. In a small Scots mining-town, a mine cave-in seals the entire crew.
1956. Fantasy. Directed by Leslie Norman. Stars Dean Jagger, Edward Chapman & Leo McKern. A radioactive creature terrorises a remote Scottish village, will anyone be able to stop it?
1959. Drama. Director: J. Lee Thompson. Stars Kenneth More, Lauren Bacall & Herbert Lom. In British India, a prince must be taken to safety across a rebel-held territory.
2000. Actor and canal enthusiast Timothy West narrates the story of the incredible engineering feats needed to build canals and meets some of the characters to be found on inland waterways today.
Surprise, Surprise. 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Deddie Davies & Eric Francis. Ida drops hints about what she wants for her upcoming birthday, but when it arrives she ends up disappointed.
Birth. Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Ada is about to become a grandmother but when Ruth's baby arrives, Leslie is at first nowhere to be found. (S4, E03)
The Waverly Ring Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Larry Blyden. THRUSH has a mole inside New York headquarters. Solo and Kuryakin are assigned to root out the double agent.
This week's first stop is Piccadilly Roundabout in 1944 wartime London, there's a slice of history from a bread factory in 1966, a reel of 1950s Italy and a look at the history of Baxter's.
